archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth) mixed with Industrial Brutalism

layouts.hero: Kinetic Hero with large typography. Masked line reveal (framer-motion). Hero overlay must be subtle. Background could be raw concrete texture or solid #F4F4F0 with absolute positioned structural elements.
layouts.services: Grid-breaking asymmetrical layout. Use bento boxes with 1px solid black borders, sharp corners (rounded-none). No shadows. Heavy use of #0A0A0A background for inverted sections.
layouts.products: Real product photography spotlighted. Clipped frames, raw unpolished presentation. Grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-px (1px borders).
layouts.contact: Functional quote form. Minimalist/Technical look. White/Grey inputs with 1px black borders. Very strict, 'blueprint' alignment.
layouts.marquee: Slow editorial marquee. Massive outline text (text-transparent stroke-black) or solid black text on safety orange background. Text: DISTRIBUCIÓN AL POR MAYOR — ACERO — CEMENTO — AGREGADOS

motion.scroll: Lenis for smooth, momentum-based scrolling. Mandatory for premium feel.
motion.reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal for hero H1. Use framer-motion overflow-hidden wrappers around text lines and translate them up.
motion.interactions: Hover states on buttons and product cards should invert colors (e.g., black to safety orange) or scale slightly. Micro-interactions should feel heavy and mechanical.

components.buttons: Industrial dictates SHARP corners (rounded-none). 1px border black, solid background, high-contrast text.
components.cards: Bento style. 1px solid borders. No rounded corners. Internal padding massive (p-8 or p-12).
components.inputs: Shadcn components, customized to remove rounded corners. 1px black border. Focus ring should be sharp safety orange.

accessibility.contrast: Extremely high contrast. Black text on off-white, or off-white on black. Passes APCA and WCAG AAA.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button'.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use generic placeholder text or icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor icons.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or fixed headers where content scrolls underneath. Use backdrop-blur and semi-solid colors.
Use 2-3x more spacing than default. Layouts must breathe.
Implement clear visual hierarchy using typography scales and grids, avoiding centered alignments for heavy text blocks.

You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or sharp button with interaction animations.
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page landing application with React/Tailwind/Shadcn UI for a wholesale construction distributor.
Ensure smooth scrolling with lenis (npm install lenis).
Implement the 'masked line reveal' hero text animation using framer-motion.
Incorporate a fast-marquee component for the 'DISTRIBUCIÓN AL POR MAYOR...' text.
Apply 'rounded-none' universally to achieve a brutalist aesthetic. Override Shadcn rounded defaults.
Create and use an original vector SVG logo (geometric construction shape) as the favicon and main logo.
Ensure the contact form is completely functional with a simulated submission saving mechanism.
For .js files, adapt imports and types appropriately since we are not using .tsx files.
Use Shadcn components for complex interactions but raw HTML/Tailwind for structural, asymmetrical layouts.
